newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, PCX to list Trigon Healthcare options May 8.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, PCX to list Trigon Healthcare options May 8.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and the Pacific Exchange (PCX) will both list options on Trigon Healthcare Inc May 8, the exchanges said separately Thursday.
The options on both exchanges will have strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expiration months of June, July, September and December 1997. Position limits are set at 7,500 contracts.

At the AMEX, LETCO-Specialists L.P. will be the specialist unit. At PCX, the options are allocated to lead market makers at Susquehanna Investment Group. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
